data.name: Control_Desc
data.value: Resource calendar for managing marketing banner placements and daily booking capacity.

data.name: Placements_Desc
data.value: The banner placements shown as rows. Each placement carries a daily capacity.

data.name: Bookings_Desc
data.value: The campaign bookings that consume placement capacity.

data.name: PlacementName_Desc
data.value: Column holding the display name of the placement.

data.name: DailyCapacity_Desc
data.value: Column holding the maximum number of bookings allowed per day.

data.name: PlacementStatus_Desc
data.value: Optional column holding the placement status, for example Active or Inactive.

data.name: CampaignName_Desc
data.value: Column holding the campaign name of the booking.

data.name: BookingPlacementId_Desc
data.value: Column holding the id of the placement this booking belongs to. Must match a placement record id.

data.name: BookingStartDate_Desc
data.value: Column holding the first day the booking occupies the placement.

data.name: BookingEndDate_Desc
data.value: Column holding the last day the booking occupies the placement, inclusive.

data.name: BookingStartTime_Desc
data.value: Optional column holding the start time as text, for example 09:00.

data.name: BookingEndTime_Desc
data.value: Optional column holding the end time as text, for example 12:00.

data.name: Requester_Desc
data.value: Optional column holding the person who requested the booking.

data.name: BookingStatus_Desc
data.value: Optional column holding the booking status, for example Confirmed or Pending.

data.name: Notes_Desc
data.value: Optional column holding free text notes for the booking.

data.name: PlacementsJson_Desc
data.value: Placements as a JSON array. Used when the Placements dataset is not bound. Example: [{"id":"p1","name":"Home Banner 1","dailyCapacity":3}]

data.name: BookingsJson_Desc
data.value: Bookings as a JSON array. Used when the Bookings dataset is not bound. Example: [{"id":"b1","campaignName":"Merdeka Sale","placementId":"p1","startDate":"2026-08-15","endDate":"2026-08-17"}]

data.name: DataMode_Desc
data.value: Which data source to read from. Auto prefers datasets, then JSON, then built-in sample data.

data.name: DataMode_Auto_Desc
data.value: Prefer datasets, fall back to JSON, then sample data.

data.name: DataMode_Dataset_Desc
data.value: Read only from the bound datasets.

data.name: DataMode_Json_Desc
data.value: Read only from the JSON properties.

data.name: DataMode_Mock_Desc
data.value: Always show built-in sample data. Useful while designing the screen.

data.name: FocusDate_Desc
data.value: The date the calendar opens on. Defaults to today.

data.name: DefaultView_Desc
data.value: The view shown when the control loads.

data.name: View_Week_Desc
data.value: One week with the bookings listed in every cell.

data.name: View_Timeline_Desc
data.value: Bookings drawn as bars across dates, one lane per overlap.

data.name: IncludeStatuses_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated booking statuses allowed into the calendar, for example "Confirmed" or "Confirmed,Pending". Leave empty to include every status. Excluded bookings are hidden and do not consume capacity. Matching ignores case; bookings with a blank status are excluded while this is set.

data.name: WeekStartsOn_Desc
data.value: First day of the week used by the Week view.

data.name: AllowCreate_Desc
data.value: Show the Add booking action when capacity is available.

data.name: AllowEdit_Desc
data.value: Allow existing bookings to be edited.

data.name: AllowDelete_Desc
data.value: Allow existing bookings to be deleted.

data.name: AllowDragDrop_Desc
data.value: Allow bookings to be moved between placements and dates by dragging.

data.name: HeaderTitle_Desc
data.value: Main heading shown at the top of the control.

data.name: HeaderSubtitle_Desc
data.value: Supporting line shown under the main heading.

data.name: KpiDensity_Desc
data.value: Size of the four capacity summary cards above the calendar.

data.name: Kpi_Compact_Desc
data.value: Smaller cards that leave more room for the calendar.

data.name: Kpi_Comfortable_Desc
data.value: Larger cards with a headline-sized figure.

data.name: Kpi_Hidden_Desc
data.value: Do not show the summary cards at all.

data.name: IsLoading_Desc
data.value: Set to true while the app is fetching data to show the loading state.

data.name: ErrorMessage_Desc
data.value: When set, the control shows this message in an error state instead of the calendar.

data.name: SelectedBookingId_Desc
data.value: Id of the booking involved in the last action.

data.name: SelectedPlacementId_Desc
data.value: Id of the placement involved in the last action.

data.name: SelectedDate_Desc
data.value: Date involved in the last action, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

data.name: LastAction_Desc
data.value: One of BookingSelected, BookingCreated, BookingUpdated, BookingDeleted or DateSelected.

data.name: LastActionPayload_Desc
data.value: JSON describing the last action, including the full booking record where relevant.

data.name: EventCount_Desc
data.value: Increments on every action so OnChange fires even when the same action repeats.

data.name: CapacityStatuses_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated booking statuses that use up daily capacity, for example "Confirmed". Other bookings are still shown, marked as pending, but leave the slot free. Leave empty to count every booking except Cancelled and Rejected.

data.name: CurrentUserEmail_Desc
data.value: Email of the signed-in user, usually User().Email. Used with Mask other bookings.

data.name: MaskOtherBookings_Desc
data.value: When on, bookings whose requester is not the current user show as "Booked", with the campaign, requester and notes hidden, and cannot be edited, moved or deleted.
